2609.20349.title: A Qualitative Model for Reasoning about Path and Support
2609.20349.paper_summary: Spatial reasoning abilities correlate strongly with performance in STEM fields. Games offer a compelling medium for training these critical skills in developing children who have a natural proclivity for play. However, to facilitate human-like tutoring and player guidance, these games require an AI agent capable of making commonsense inferences from spatial events. Qualitative reasoning (QR) models appear to be a suitable framework for these application domains. As these models reason in symbolic representations, they can seamlessly translate game states into interpretable feedback for human-like player guidance. This paper introduces a hybrid qualitative model designed for Camelot Jr., a block-puzzle game that requires constructing multi-level bridges to connect two avatars stationed on separate towers. The game poses a challenge for the player, who must make platforms stable, plan their path, and ensure they use all the provided blocks. To handle the precise physics required by the domain, we integrate a mathematical center-of-mass stability logic to guide our qualitative solver. Our work facilitates spatial skill training in Camelot Jr. and contributes to the development of human-centric, explainable game-playing agents.
2609.20349.paper_summary_zh: 空間推理能力與STEM領域的表現有著強烈的相關性。遊戲提供了一個引人入勝的媒介，用於培養這些關鍵技能，以幫助那些天生喜愛遊玩的孩子。然而，為了促進類人輔導和玩家指導，這些遊戲需要一個能夠從空間事件中做出常識推斷的AI代理。質性推理（QR）模型似乎是這些應用領域的合適框架。由於這些模型以符號表示進行推理，它們可以無縫地將遊戲狀態轉換為可解釋的反饋，以便進行類人玩家指導。本文介紹了一個為Camelot Jr.設計的混合質性模型，這是一個需要構建多層橋樑以連接駐紮在不同塔樓上的兩個化身的積木拼圖遊戲。這款遊戲對玩家提出了挑戰，玩家必須使平台穩定、規劃路徑，並確保使用所有提供的積木。為了處理該領域所需的精確物理，我們整合了一個數學質心穩定邏輯來指導我們的質性求解器。我們的工作促進了Camelot Jr.中的空間技能訓練，並有助於開發以人為中心的可解釋遊戲代理。
